name: Panner
description:
The ever-shifting mineral deposits around Mount Ardis have taught you that every stream offers a chance to get rich quick.

Whenever you take a long rest near a watercourse, you may spend one hour panning for gold and other valuable minerals. At the end of the hour, roll a d8. On an 8, you find minerals worth 1d4 Treasure.

Describe your technique and what you find.
